# `version-bump-too-small`

Version bump smaller than the changes need

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `warn` |
| **Rule IDs** | `version-bump-too-small` |
| **Status** | Planned (M6) |
| **Group** | Lifecycle and versions ([RULES.md section 9](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

The recorded version changed less than the findings require, e.g. a minor bump with breaking changes.

## Why this default

Consumers relying on semantic versioning upgrade without expecting breakage.

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

Options for this rule:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `scheme` | `semver` | `semver`, `calver` or `none` (turns this rule off). |

```yaml
rules:
  version-bump-too-small: warn
```

## How to fix

Bump the major version, or avoid the breaking change.
